title: USO incident at Pascagoula

tellings.quote: but a week or two later, there was a genuine USO incident right there.

plain: In 1973 in Pascagoula, Mississippi, a week or two after an earlier sighting there, there was what the UFO historian Richard Dolan calls a genuine USO incident: an unidentified submerged object, something seen moving underwater. He mentions it briefly on Michels's show without naming a source, as support for the strange events in that town.
